newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani money market rates close high.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani money market rates close high.

text.p: Pakistani money market rates rose to 18 percent on Thursday from Wednesday's close at 17 percent as conditions remained dry, dealers said.
The conditions were dry owing to a shortage of funds, and considerable amounts were traded between 17.50 and 18 percent, above the discount rate of 17 percent, one dealer said.
The coming week is likely to remain on the higher end as the market continues to close short with no major inflows in sight, the dealer said.
